This dataset contains the forty-five (45) scans of Pacific Steam Whaling Co. Community House. All data was collected by the Capture2Preserv team. There are fifteen (15) exterior scans collected with the Z+F 5010X scanner on August 16th, 2018. There are thirty (30) interior scans collected with the Leica BLK 360 on July 30th, 2019. The exterior scans were registered in Laser Control V. 8.9 and then exported to AutoDesk ReCap V. 6.1 to be registered with the interior scans. All the interior scans were registered and processed with AutoDesk ReCap V.6.1.
